secrets.name: DATABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase Postgres transaction pooler connection string (port 6543). From Supabase Dashboard → Project Settings → Database → Connection string (URI). Used by the app at runtime.

secrets.name: DIRECT_URL
secrets.description: Supabase Postgres direct connection string (port 5432). From Supabase Dashboard → Project Settings → Database → Connection string (URI). Used by Prisma CLI commands.

secrets.name: TMDB_API_KEY
secrets.description: TMDB (The Movie Database) API key from https://www.themoviedb.org/settings/api. Accepts the v3 API Key (32-char) or v4 Read Access Token (JWT starting with eyJ). Required for movie/TV content to load.

secrets.name: NEXTAUTH_SECRET
secrets.description: NextAuth JWT signing secret. Auto-generated for development; replace with your own for production.
